title: AI SOC Engineer
short_description: We are hiring a Security Engineer to advance the AI and automation layer, and support the SOC when incidents demand engineering depth.
job_description:
AI SOC Engineer
Zentara Technologies
| Gading Serpong, Tangerang, Indonesia | Full-time, On-site
About Zentara
Zentara Technologies is a cybersecurity and enterprise technology company headquartered in Tangerang, Indonesia, with a regional office in Singapore. We run a 24/7 Managed SOC on top of them for institutions where downtime carries real consequences.
Our operations are certified to ISO 27001 for information security and ISO 42001 for AI management. Our R&D arm, Zentara Labs, moves research into production, and our SOC feeds real operational data back into the lab. You would work at exactly that intersection.
The Role
We are hiring a Security Engineer to advance the AI and automation layer of our detection and response stack, and to stand behind the SOC when incidents demand engineering depth.
Half the job is building. You will develop & maintain AI features and automation for SIEM and you will help build SOAR, our security orchestration, automation, and response platform currently in development. The other half is operational. When the SOC needs technical or forensic support during an active incident, that call comes to you.
This is a builder role with production accountability. What you ship, the SOC runs. Every day.
What You Will Do
Design, build, and tune AI features for the SIEM platform: anomaly detection models, contextual threat scoring, and automated alert triage
Develop SOAR from its current state toward production: response playbooks, case management workflows, and automated containment actions integrated with SIEM
Build and maintain integrations across the stack: log sources, EDR, threat intelligence feeds, ticketing, and patch management. Integrate with 200+ data sources, and you will extend that coverage for client environments
Automate SOC workflows end to end: alert enrichment, escalation paths, and response actions mapped to our SLA tiers
Support SOC analysts on the technical side of incident response and DFIR: log, disk and memory forensics, malware triage, and root cause investigation during escalations
Document what you build. Runbooks, integration guides, and playbook logic that an analyst can follow without you in the room
What You Bring
Required
3+ years in security engineering, SOC engineering, or detection engineering
Strong Python for security tooling, automation, and data pipelines
Hands-on SIEM experience: content development, log parsing, normalization, and correlation rule design (any major platform)
Experience building or operating SOAR playbooks and automated response workflows
Working DFIR knowledge: incident response process, forensic artifact analysis, timeline reconstruction, malware triage
API integration experience: REST, webhooks, and queue-based pipelines
Applied ML on security data: anomaly detection, classification, or model evaluation in a detection context
Working fluency with MITRE ATT&CK and NIST incident response frameworks
Able to join an on-call rotation for critical incident support
Preferred
Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GCED, or OSCP
Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Kafka, or similar log pipeline components
Container and cloud platform experience (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure) for deploying detection infrastructure
Prior work in an MSSP or managed SOC environment
Contributions to open-source security tooling
Why This Role
You will not be configuring someone else's product. You will be building ours, and watching it run against live threats the same week. Your detection logic protects banks, government institutions, and enterprises across the region. Your automation shortens response times that are measured against contractual SLAs, not vibes.
You also get opportunity to collaborate with Zentara Labs. Research projects, AI/ML development under an ISO 42001 certified management system, and a pipeline of products (SOAR among them) where early engineers shape the architecture.
What We Offer
Competitive salary, adjusted to experience and certifications
Certification sponsorship and dedicated training budget
Health insurance
Modern office at BAIC Tower, Gading Serpong, with the SOC and engineering teams on the same floor
A 40+ person team where your work is visible to leadership, not buried under layers
Zentara Technologies. Built by Minds Not from This World.

title: Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer (AI-Native)

About the role
PT Monica HijauLestari is seeking an
Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer (AI-Native)
. This is a strategic position designed to support our organisation's infrastructure and deployment operations with a forward-thinking, AI-native approach. You will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, whilst leveraging modern AI and automation tools to enhance operational efficiency. This position is integral to ensuring our systems remain secure, scalable, and resilient whilst embracing cutting-edge technologies that drive our digital transformation.
Key responsibilities
Design, deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure and on-premises systems that support the organisation's applications and services
Develop and optimise CI/CD pipelines to automate software build, test and deployment processes
Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation or Ansible to ensure reproducible and version-controlled infrastructure
Monitor system performance, availability and security, implementing proactive measures to identify and resolve issues before they impact operations
Collaborate with development teams to understand application requirements and design scalable infrastructure solutions
Implement and maintain containerisation technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes, to support modern application deployment
Establish and maintain logging, monitoring and alerting systems to provide visibility into infrastructure health and application performance
Conduct security audits, manage access controls and implement best practices for infrastructure security and compliance
Leverage AI-native tools and automation frameworks to optimise infrastructure management, reduce manual tasks and improve operational efficiency
Document infrastructure architecture, processes and runbooks to facilitate knowledge sharing and operational continuity
What we're looking for
Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of experience in infrastructure and systems administration, with a demonstrated focus on DevOps practices and cloud platforms
Strong expertise with at least one major cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Proficiency in containerisation technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes, with experience orchestrating containerised workloads in production environments
Advanced knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices, with hands-on experience using platforms such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or similar solutions
Solid understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles and experience with tools including Terraform, CloudFormation or Ansible
Experience with monitoring, logging and observability platforms such as Prometheus, ELK Stack, Grafana or Datadog
Strong scripting skills in languages such as Python, Bash or similar, with the ability to automate routine infrastructure tasks
Knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts (specifically Claude Code), with an understanding of how to design infrastructure to support AI/ML workloads and large language model (LLM) applications
Familiarity with AI-native development and deployment tools, including experience with AI automation frameworks or AI-assisted development platforms
Excellent problem-solving abilities and experience working in fast-paced, collaborative environments

title: AI-Native Tech Lead
short_description: Lead our AI-native engineering team building Bali's leading wedding operations platform
job_description:
Why this role exists
Bali Love is a full-stack wedding operations platform — not just a website. It manages bookings, vendor coordination, invoicing, and payments for high-value events across Bali.. The founder is currently the most effective developer on the team. That's the problem.
We have a defined engineering process and a team that uses Claude Code agent sessions day-to-day. What we're missing is a technical leader who can own delivery, enforce the process, and make sure the founder doesn't have to step in every time something breaks.
The setup
You'd be leading a team of four: one tech lead and three developers. The stack is a Next.js / React Native full-stack application with a Postgres database, integrated with Xero for accounting and Clerk for auth. The team already works with Claude Code — AI-augmented development is how we build.
The engineering process exists on paper. The gap is execution and accountability.
What we expect
In your first days, you'll do a quick audit of the codebase and current processes — what's working, what isn't, and what you'd fix first. After that:
Own delivery: every ticket has a lead, every PR gets reviewed, nothing stalls
Fix deployment reliability — there's a known fragility we need resolved and documented
Set clear SLAs for code review and QA handoffs
Manage the team day-to-day: unblock, hold accountable, develop
Work in Claude Code alongside the team — you'll be expected to run agent sessions and review their output
What success looks like
The founder doesn't need to get involved when something breaks,
deployments are predictable, the team handles incidents on their own, and nothing is sitting in the pipeline without an owner.
What we're looking for
5+ years of engineering, with real lead experience — you've owned delivery, not just code
You've enforced process in a team that wasn't following one
AI-native: Claude Code or equivalent agent-based tools are part of your daily workflow
Strong written communication — you document decisions and don't rely on chat as a source of truth
Based in Bali — in-person presence with the team is part of the role
What we offer
IDR 35,000,000 – 45,000,000/month
B2B contract — your preferred payment setup
Real ownership; if this works, there's a long-term role here

Founded in the early nineties, OTAZEN has grown into a world-class leader in the furniture manufacturing and logistics industry, exporting high-quality products across five continents. We cater to diverse sectors, including luxury hotels, domestic markets, and large-scale commercial contracts.
Operating out of our own advanced, independent production facilities equipped with cutting-edge woodworking technology, we pride ourselves on being completely self-sufficient and independent from external manufacturers. Our production processes adhere strictly to European quality standards and global sustainability initiatives, backed by annual FSC, COC, and SVLK certifications. At OTAZEN, we are our own most demanding customer, constantly creating and implementing global, innovative solutions to accelerate our business and support our international clients.
Job Overview
As we accelerate our digital transformation journey, we are looking for an entrepreneurial
Data Science & AI Manager
to act as the
Founding Leader
of our newly established Data & AI division.
Because this is a
"Zero-to-One"
phase, you will initially operate as a highly technical
Individual Contributor
during the first 6–12 months. You will be responsible for getting your hands dirty—writing code, building data pipelines, and deploying production-ready AI solutions to optimize our manufacturing, supply chain, and enterprise workflows. As your solutions scale and drive measurable business impact, you will have the full authority to design the hiring roadmap, manage the budget, and build your own Data Science and AI team from the ground up.
Key Responsibilities
Hands-on AI & Data Development:
Architect, build, and deploy the company’s very first production-grade AI models, RAG systems, and data pipelines from scratch.
AI Strategy & Use-Case Identification:
Collaborate directly with the executive team (C-Level) to translate manufacturing, logistics, and business challenges into scalable AI solutions (e.g., supply chain optimization, predictive maintenance, automated contract analysis, or internal knowledge management).
Modern AI Integration:
Explore and implement advanced Generative AI frameworks, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic Workflows, alongside traditional Machine Learning models.
End-to-End MLOps:
Establish robust MLOps practices using cloud infrastructure to ensure all deployed models are cost-effective, secure, low-latency, and highly reliable.
Team Expansion & Future Leadership:
Define technical hiring criteria, conduct technical interviews, and gradually build a high-performing team of Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and Data Engineers as the division expands.
Technical Bridge:
Act as the primary communicator between complex technical architectures and business outcomes, presenting milestones to non-technical stakeholders clearly.
Requirements & Qualifications
Experience & Mindset:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
Minimum of
5 years
of professional experience in Data Science or AI Engineering, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade systems.
A strong
"Zero-to-One" mentality
: Excited about working independently in the early stages, writing code, and deploying systems without relying on an existing team.
Demonstrated potential or prior experience in technical project management, mentoring, or team leadership.
Technical Skills:
Expert proficiency in
Python
and standard ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Pandas).
Strong hands-on experience with
Generative AI
architectures: LLM fine-tuning, RAG frameworks (Vector & Knowledge Graph), LangGraph/LangChain, and Agentic AI.
Proficiency in relational databases (SQL/PostgreSQL) and Vector Databases (e.g., Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus).
Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (
AWS or Google Cloud Platform
) along with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker & Kubernetes) for deployment.
Familiarity with data streaming, automated workflows (like n8n), or applying AI to industrial/logistics data is a significant plus.
Soft Skills:
Exceptional problem-solving skills and resilience in a dynamic, evolving environment.
High level of professional autonomy and excellent time management.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills in English (both written and verbal) to collaborate with global stakeholders.

job_description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines — from ingestion and transformation through to dashboards and applications consumed by end users — with a strong focus on solving the underlying business problem, not just delivering technical output.
Develop and maintain BI dashboards and reports used by clinical, operational, and management stakeholders, ensuring metrics are accurate, well-defined, and actionable.
Build and maintain full-stack internal applications from initial scoping through production deployment.
Manage frequent deployments across multiple systems; ensure every system shipped is maintainable, well-documented, and traceable so issues can be diagnosed and ownership can be transferred.
Ensure data traceability across all pipelines and reports — every number delivered to a stakeholder can be traced back to its source, transformation logic, and assumptions.
Establish and follow engineering practices including version control (Git), CI/CD, and structured logging to keep a solo-operated system landscape reliable and auditable.
Stay current and able to build developments integrated with AI/LLM models with tooling, and evaluate where new model capabilities can be applied to hospital data and automation use cases.
Work directly with non-technical stakeholders to translate vague business questions into concrete data or application requirements, and communicate results in plain language.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / others related major
Proficiency in SQL on production datasets, and in Python for data processing and pipeline development. (Familiar with PostgreSQL & MongoDB )
Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase) delivering dashboards used in production by business stakeholders.
Full-stack development experience, including version control workflows and CI/CD pipelines. ( Preferred experiences with Next.js, React, Go, FastAPI )
Proven ability to operate as an engineer: scoping, building, deploying, and maintaining systems end-to-end without a supporting team, and prioritizing across multiple concurrent requests.
An end-to-end pipeline mindset. Thinks from data sources all the way to the end user. Deep specialization is less important than the ability to ship working, maintainable solutions.
Strong understanding of data traceability and system maintainability; comfortable being accountable for many deployed systems and able to keep them documented, monitored, and debuggable.
Awareness of the current AI/LLM model landscape and its practical applications, with the judgment to know when (and when not) to apply them.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in both Bahasa Indonesia and English across technical and business teams.
Understanding of data sensitivity and access control practices, particularly in a healthcare or regulated-data environment (preferred: exposure to hospital information systems, HL7/FHIR, or BPJS data).
